name: Marid
senses: darkvision, detect alignment, detect magic, imprecise wavesense 60

traits.name: Vortex
traits.text: (aura, water); 40 feet. Water in the aura that is also in the same body of water as the marid is difficult terrain for Swimming creatures. Creatures with the water trait are immune.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (arcane, concentrate, polymorph, transmutation); The marid can take on the appearance of any water elemental or humanoid. This ability doesn't change the marid's Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes.

traits.name: Rush of Water
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, water); The marid releases a jet of water in a 60-foot line, dealing 9d6 (9d6) bludgeoning damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). A creature that fails its save is also pushed 10 feet (20 feet on a critical failure). The marid can't use Rush of Water again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Skewer
traits.text: ⬻ The marid makes a trident Strike, dealing an extra 2d6 (2d6) persistent bleed damage on a hit (4d6 (4d6) on a critical hit).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +20 (agile, magical, nonlethal, reach 10 feet); Damage 1d4+11 (1d4+11) bludgeoning
